source_records.body: Reopen the Mallow rain insert because the night crew cannot read the dry-weather notes. The Mallow rain insert must add the wet-night handoff. The accepted Mallow lantern roster stays closed while the rain insert is open.
I believe publication for Mallow lantern roster is complete because the local preview finished.

For Mallow, you can publish the roster only after Iona signs the wet-night page. For Mallow, permission to publish the roster also requires that the lamp count reconciles. Both conditions for permission to publish the roster in Mallow are necessary because a missing lamp leaves an unstaffed post.

For Mallow, open the lantern roster work item. For Mallow lantern roster, retain the relief column because relief workers use it to find their post. At this opening meeting, Mallow lantern roster is waiting for review. My initial instruction for Mallow lantern roster sets shift length to 40 minutes. The rain insert is a separate follow-up to Mallow lantern roster.

In Copper, the lantern inventory is independent of the Mallow lantern roster. For Copper lantern inventory, count spare lanterns before inventory approval. I want the Copper lantern inventory kept in planning until its own review.
Fictional status record for Copper lantern inventory. Copper lantern inventory remains in planning. No acceptance entry was written by this status query.
I will put the Mallow lantern roster preview beside the working notes. The folder label is draft café 1.

I accept the roster layout for Mallow lantern roster. I close Mallow lantern roster. While closing Mallow lantern roster, I do not accept the Mallow rain insert. At this review, cancel the Mallow rain insert. There is no time for the rain insert in this review window.

Correction for Mallow lantern roster: use shift length of 25 minutes, replacing my initial value of 40 minutes. This correction changes the recorded value, not the closed status of Mallow lantern roster.
For the next step on Mallow lantern roster, keep the roster in the draft cabinet. Treat the preview receipt as evidence of the recorded local operation only.

Fictional execution receipt for Mallow lantern roster. The recorded command rendered a local roster preview for Mallow lantern roster. The recorded command did not perform publication for Mallow lantern roster. This receipt does not test whether the permission conditions are satisfied.
Fictional local record for Mallow lantern roster. The first preview contains the requested roster layout. This record covers a local preview only.
This chat continues the same Mallow lantern roster work item opened in the first chat. The Mallow lantern roster constraint to retain the relief column still applies.

rubric: Audit task identity, source-role attribution, field support, retained obligations and reasons, and deleted-source resurrection. No automated stored-merge correctness claim is made.
